core_question: When does Hamiltonian structure improve cross-energy prediction and cyclic control after accounting for representation, mechanical priors, coverage and optimization?
scope: Convex Fourier-feature mechanistic benchmark; no general deep-HNN or novelty claim
integrator: RK4, five substeps of 0.01; no speed clipping
strict_success: Euclidean momentum error < 0.25 throughout final 20 states
domain_exit_rule: reset nonfinite states or any |p_i|>10; log exits; finite exit transitions retained
checkpoint_selection: final checkpoint only; no test selection
reference_count: 3 unique true-only runs, not duplicated across world seeds
statistics: paired initial states; report crossed cells and marginal seed variation; no IID-cell significance test
posthoc_extensions: Any follow-up must receive a separate protocol before its outcomes
